critic_invalidation_policy.rule: A passing critic remains valid across a later candidate when the changed production/tooling paths do not intersect that critic's reviewed domain and an impact proof binds the prior exact-source pass to the later candidate.
critic_invalidation_policy.prompt_or_runner_change: Invalidate only the critic whose prompt/runner/review protocol changed, unless the shared evidence contract itself changed.
critic_invalidation_policy.product_change: Invalidate only critics whose mandatory checks can be materially affected by the changed production paths/behavior.
preserved_pass_requirements: prior critic record passed every mandatory dimension strictly above 9.0 unrounded
prior record has zero unresolved defects and complete coverage
candidate diff is enumerated and mapped to critic domains
deterministic invariant checks for the preserved critic pass
preservation is recorded as carry-forward provenance, never represented as a fresh rerun
no score averaging or threshold change

standard_task_branch_set: one task review/controller branch when independent review tooling is needed
one task approval/closeout branch when write authority must be isolated
new_branch_allowed_only_when: a genuinely separate long-lived product line is required
ownership/path collision makes same-branch work unsafe
security or release isolation explicitly requires a distinct branch
required_new_branch_record: why an existing branch cannot be reused
branch_minimization_policy.stale_scratch_branch_policy: Do not create replacements. Finish the task on the standard branch set; archive/delete obsolete scratch branches during cleanup after closeout.
